prompt.default: Mark the sentence in which the writer gives their main argument, and the words that signal a contrast.

text.$comment: paragraphs separated by an empty line, **bold**, *italic*; empty: the example (with its categories and key)

categories.$comment: JSON [{id, name, short, color, pattern}] or names per line (name | pattern | colour); empty: one category

key.$comment: word ranges with their category, as the response: "69-69:b 93-110:a"; words count from 0

scoring.$comment: JSON {tolerance, rule: overlap|all|exact, minOverlap, points, partial, penalty}; empty: the defaults

label.en: Maximum number of marks (0: no limit)
Maximum words per mark (0: no limit)
label.nl: Maximum aantal woorden per markering (0: geen grens)

label.en: Show the category label at the start of each mark
label.nl: Label van de categorie aan het begin van elke markering

label.en: Language of the source text (de, fr, ar…; empty: the language below)
label.nl: Taal van de brontekst (de, fr, ar…; leeg: de taal hieronder)

label.en: Maximum height of the text in px; it scrolls (0: no limit)
label.nl: Maximale hoogte van de tekst in px; hij scrollt (0: geen grens)
